inventory: sha256 of the harness's libtest --list --format terse names (': test' removed), in listed order, joined by LF, no trailing LF
trust: No unpinned candidate code runs before A7's evidence is sealed; the only candidate-reachable code during A7 is pinned build-time code (third party pinned by a Cargo.lock equal to the lock digest in the submitted pins file (`tools/route_pins.json`, whose sha256 the request commits to) and the AM-1 item 3 list), which falls under assumption 6. Pinned build-time code (third party pinned by a Cargo.lock equal to the lock digest in the submitted pins file (`tools/route_pins.json`, whose sha256 the request commits to) and the AM-1 item 3 list) and its descendants are assumed not to alter A7's evidence, verdict path or the harness; quiescence and sealing protect only against later writers and cannot authenticate earlier writes. The inventory hash is a commitment, not execution attestation: trust includes the submitter (gatesubmit), review-record custody and reviewed harness behaviour, including that the running harness does not replace its own pathname, which would change the bytes its children execute (SB3E-R20). The pins file is chosen by the submitter: the box refuses drift from it, not from the reviewed base. Only credit compares its digest with the independently reviewed one.
limitations: The /opt/rust manifest pin fixes toolchain content at checking time only; the toolchain stays a mutable trusted host input.
